prompt: Create a luxury editorial studio portrait of a confident young Black man in his early 20s seated on minimalist white geometric blocks, centered in a square composition. He wears an immaculate all-white formal outfit: tailored white suit jacket, white waistcoat with subtle buttons, white dress shirt, white tie, slim white trousers, white socks, and glossy white dress shoes, with one discreet silver wristwatch visible. Pose him seated with legs crossed, one hand resting relaxed on his knee and the other elbow propped on a tall white cube, fingertips lightly touching his temple. Use a calm direct gaze, soft closed-mouth smile, polished grooming, and short neat black fade haircut. The background is an elegant draped silver-gray satin fabric with soft folds and a premium studio feel. Lighting should be high-end portrait lighting: large softbox illumination from the front-left, gentle fill, smooth skin tones, crisp facial detail, subtle shadows under the blocks, and no harsh contrast. The mood is refined, aspirational, clean, and luxurious, like a fashion magazine or personal branding portrait. Use realistic photography, sharp focus on the face, natural proportions, 85mm portrait lens look, shallow-to-medium depth of field, square crop, no text, no watermark, no extra props.

promptZh: 创作一张奢华的杂志风格影棚肖像，主角是一位自信的年轻人 20 多岁的黑人男性，他坐在一组极简的白色几何方块上，构图居中且呈正方形。他身着无可挑剔的全白正装：剪裁合身的白色西装外套、带有精致纽扣的白色马甲、白色衬衫、白色领带、修身白色长裤、白色袜子和亮面白色正装皮鞋，手腕上佩戴着一块低调的银色腕表。姿势设定为坐姿，双腿交叉，一只手自然地放在膝盖上，另一只手肘支撑在高大的白色方块上，指尖轻触太阳穴。表情为平静的直视镜头，嘴角带着柔和的微笑，妆容精致，留着整洁的 黑色渐变短发。背景是优雅的垂褶 银灰色缎面织物，带有柔和的褶皱，营造出高级影棚的质感。灯光采用高端肖像布光：左前方使用大型柔光箱照明，辅以柔和的补光，呈现平滑的肤色、清晰的面部细节，方块下方带有微妙的阴影，避免强烈的对比。整体氛围精致、充满抱负、简洁且奢华，如同时尚杂志或个人品牌肖像。采用写实摄影风格，面部焦点清晰，比例自然，呈现 85mm 肖像镜头的视觉效果，景深为浅至中等，正方形裁剪，无文字，无水印，无额外道具。
